Name: Quick Descend By Using Staircase
Author: kun2331
Description:
[b]Introduction:
[/b]Quick descend desert mine (skull cave) by using staircase. Each layer need at least one staircase. Default time will pass when single player games and time will automatically pause when enter into desert mine.

[b]Unlocked condition: [/b]
1. reach the 1st layer at the Skull Cavern.
2. meet Dwarf and reached the 500 points (two hearts) with Dwarf.
3. next day you will receive a mail send by Dwarf and then unlocked.

[b]Attention:[/b]
1. It will be reblocked at the desert festival days. (if the key "QSIgnoreLimit" == false)
2. support Mod "Generic Mod Config Menu" to set the config.

[b]v1.1:[/b]
1. Time will pass when single player games(10 minutes per stride, maximum is 60 minutes).
2. Add easier recipe of staircase(10 woods and 10 stones).
3. You can not descend after 24:00.

[b]v1.1.1:[/b]
1. Time will automatically pause when enter into desert mine.


[b]介绍：[/b]
使用楼梯快速下降骷髅矿洞。每一层至少需要一个楼梯。默认单人游戏时时间会流逝，并且进入沙漠矿井时，时间会自动暂停。

[b]解锁条件：[/b]
1. 已到达骷髅矿洞1层。
2. 认识矮人且与矮人友谊达到500分，即2心。
3. 第二天将会收到矮人邮件并解锁。

[b]注意：[/b]
1. 在沙漠节期间将会重新上锁，可以设置 "QSIgnoreLimit" == true 以取消。
2. 支持通用配置菜单模组进行参数设置。

[b]v1.1:[/b]
1. 单人游戏时时间会流逝(每一阶段消耗10分钟，最多消耗60分钟)。
2. 添加简易楼梯配方(10木材10石头)。
3. 24:00后不能下降。

[b]v1.1.1:[/b]
1. 当进入沙漠矿井时，时间会自动暂停。
